teaser: At six in the morning, before anyone else in the house stirs, you stand dressed, coffee poured and waiting. The number is 11, a path built on a kind of knowing most people never slow down enough to notice; the letters are ESTJ, built for clear command of the visible world. The two rarely sit easily in one person. The 11 hands you a sense of what is coming before it arrives; the ESTJ in you wants it logged, scheduled, and proven true before the dishes are even cleared from breakfast.
